scripts.db:restart: pnpm run db:stop && pnpm run db:start
scripts.site:build: pnpm run site:sync-cards && cd site && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.site:dev: pnpm run site:sync-cards && cd site && bundle exec jekyll serve
scripts.spacetime:generate: pnpm spacetime:bundle && docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/project" clockworklabs/spacetime:latest generate --lang typescript -j /project/spacetimedb/dist/bundle.js -o /project/client/src/generated -y --include-private
scripts.spacetime:publish: pnpm spacetime:bundle && docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/project" -v spiritbound-cli-config:/home/spacetime/.config/spacetime clockworklabs/spacetime:latest publish --no-config -j /project/spacetimedb/dist/bundle.js --server maincloud spiritbound
scripts.spacetime:publish:local: pnpm run db:restart && pnpm spacetime:bundle && docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/project" clockworklabs/spacetime:latest publish --anonymous --no-config -j /project/spacetimedb/dist/bundle.js --server http://host.docker.internal:3000 spiritbound --yes
